description: Artificial intelligence has combed through decades of Hubble Space Telescope data, revealing hundreds of unusual celestial objects that astronomers had missed. ESA’s AnomalyMatch neural network scanned around 100 million image cutouts in just days, flagging more than 1,300 anomalies. Among them are colliding galaxies, rare gravitational lenses, and jellyfish galaxies, demonstrating how AI can rapidly unlock discoveries hidden within vast astronomical archives. The project highlights a new era where machines partner with scientists to explore the universe efficiently and faster.
title: AI Identifies More Than 1,300 Unusual Objects in Hubble Space Telescope Images

description: Smartwatches under Rs. 15,000 in India now offer a strong mix of style, performance, and health features. Popular options include the Amazfit Active 2, Huawei Watch Fit 4, OnePlus Watch 2, Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 Classic, and Amazfit Balance. These models deliver AMOLED displays, comprehensive health and fitness tracking, GPS support, smart features like Bluetooth calling, and reliable battery life. With varied designs and software experiences, they cater to different needs, making it easier to choose a capable smartwatch without exceeding a mid-range budget.
title: Best Smartwatches Under Rs 15,000 in India: Huawei Watch Fit 4, OnePlus Watch 2, Amazfit Balance and More

description: Crypto wrench attacks witnessed a massive surge in 2025, with both the number of incidents and the total losses over the year reaching an all-time high, a new report stated. As per the report by a cybersecurity firm, these violent means to extort cryptocurrency and related digital assets from individuals grew by 75 percent year-on-year (YoY) in 2025.
title: Crypto Wrench Attacks Surged in 2025, Total Recorded Losses Hit $41 Million: Report

description: Motorola Razr 70, the smartphone maker’s purported foldable handset, has been spotted on the UAE’s TDRA certification database, a tipster claims. The phone was reportedly spotted on the website with the XT2657-8 model number. While the listing does not reveal any other details about the foldable, the development suggests that Motorola’s rumoured foldable smartphone could be launched soon in select global markets. This comes soon after multiple Motorola handsets, including the Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, Razr 70 Ultra, Moto G17, and Moto G67, reportedly received regulatory approval in the UAE.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Global Launch Seems Imminent as Foldable Phone Visits UAE’s TDRA Certification Database

description: Philips has launched five new audio products in India, spanning soundbars, a Bluetooth speaker, and wired headphones. The lineup includes the TAB4230 soundbar, TAS4400 Bluetooth speaker, TAB4120 Mini Soundbar, TAA1009 in-ear sports headphones, and SHP9500 over-ear headphones. Prices start at Rs. 899 and go up to Rs. 19,999, with availability across major online platforms and offline stores. Key features include Dolby Digital audio, magnetic speaker design, sweat-resistant earphones, and open-back headphones aimed at both everyday users and audio enthusiasts.
title: Philips TAA1009 In-Ear, SHP9500 Headphones Launched in India Alongside New Soundbar, Speaker Models

description: A rapidly expanding sunspot has transformed the Sun into a solar flare powerhouse, producing more than 20 mid-level flares and several extreme eruptions in just one day. As the region now faces Earth, scientists are tracking potential radio blackouts, satellite interference, and dazzling auroras caused by incoming solar storms.
title: Scientists Track Rapidly Growing Sunspot Behind Intense Solar Storms Toward Earth

description: NASA’s Mars rover, Perseverance, recently completed its first drive using commands shared by Anthropic’s artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot, Claude. The milestone marks the first time a generative AI model has played a direct role in planning a rover’s movement on another planet. The drive took place on January 27, with Claude delivering high-level navigation instructions that were translated into precise waypoints before transmission to Mars.
title: NASA’s Perseverance Makes History on Mars with Claude AI at the Helm

description: Nintendo Switch has surpassed Nintendo DS to become the company's best-selling console of all time. Switch sales reached 55.37million units as of December 31, 2025, Nintendo confirmed in its latest financial report. Nintendo Switch 2, on the other hand, has now sold 17.37million units.
title: Nintendo Switch Becomes Best-Selling Nintendo Console Ever; Switch 2 Sales Cross 17 Million Units

description: Redmi K90 Ultra will be launched by the Xiaomi sub-brand with an 8,500mAh or larger battery, a tipster claims. The Chinese smartphone maker will reportedly equip the rumoured handset with an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset, instead of Qualcomm’s octa core 3nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset found on the existing Redmi K90 lineup. Earlier, the Redmi K90 Ultra was expected to be unveiled with a 10,000mAh cell. However, the latest leak claim contradicts this. The phone is said to be the third addition to the tech firm’s Redmi K90 lineup.
title: Redmi K90 Ultra Tipped to Launch With Dimensity 9500 Chip, Active Cooling Fan

description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday warned it could reimpose a ban on Meta-owned WhatsApp's data sharing with other group entities, saying the messaging app's privacy policy misled users, two lawyers present in court said.
title: Supreme Court Questions WhatsApp Policy of Sharing User Data With Meta Entities

title: Mozilla Firefox Will Let You Decide How Much AI You Want in Your Browser

Previous Nioh games are only available on PC, PS4, and PS5.
title: Nioh 3 Will Be a PS5 Console Exclusive for 6 Months, Could Launch on Other Platforms Later This Year

The handsets are expected to be launched at higher prices than their predecessors, which were unveiled in India in March 2025. More details are expected to be revealed in the coming days.

It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9400+ SoC and packs a 6,200mAh battery.
title: Vivo X200T With Triple 50-Megapixel Zeiss Cameras Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Vivo X300 series will reportedly get two more smartphones, dubbed Vivo X300 Max and Vivo X300 Ultra, after the Chinese Spring Festival. This means that the handsets could be unveiled by the tech firm after March 3. However, the company has yet to confirm that these rumoured models are in development. It could be powered by a 3nm octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, paired with a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Vivo X300 Max Tipped to Launch in March Alongside the Vivo X300 Ultra: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Google is reportedly testing a new feature for Gemini, which is aimed at making it easier for users of other chatbots to switch to Google’s artificial intelligence (AI) platform. As per the report, the Mountain View-based tech giant is working on an “Import AI chats” feature that lets users bring the entire chat history on a different platform, such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT, to Gemini.
title: Google to Reportedly Make Switching From ChatGPT to Gemini Hassle-Free

description: Infinix’s upcoming Note 60 series has appeared in multiple listings and certifications, hinting at an India launch. Carlcare listings reveal RAM and storage options for the Note 60, Note 60 Pro, and Note 60 Ultra. TÜV records suggest region-specific battery sizes, while other leaks confirm chipset choices, charging speeds, and display details. The Note 60 and Note 60 Pro have surfaced on certification platforms, and Infinix has already confirmed the Note 60 Ultra, designed in partnership with Pininfarina, for a 2026 launch.
title: Infinix Note 60, Note 60 Pro, Note 60 Ultra Memory Variants Leaked Ahead of Anticipated Launch in India

description: OpenAI has released the Codex app for macOS, a dedicated desktop application designed to help developers manage and collaborate with multiple AI coding agents at once. The new app gives programmers a macOS-native interface where teams of artificial intelligence (AI) agents can run tasks in parallel, organise workflows by thread, and interact with code repositories directly.
title: OpenAI Introduces Codex App With Agentic Coding for macOS

description: Samsung on Tuesday announced that it has set two new Guinness World Records through its India #WithGalaxy photography campaign. As per the South Korean tech conglomerate, the campaign secured the record for the largest online photo album of images taken using smartphones. The India #WithGalaxy campaign invited users across the country to submit photographs captured on Samsung Galaxy smartphones across a diverse range of themes.
title: Samsung India's Smartphone Photography Competition Secures Two Guinness World Records

description: Truecaller has started rolling out its new Community Suggestions feature in India. Now, when a known or unknown caller will contact you, their contact card will display tags, including their profession, company, location, or role. This is claimed to provide context and information about the caller, helping users decide whether they should take the call or not. The company claims that it will censor personal and derogatory words from being displayed. Moreover, the tags will only be displayed once a certain number of users have submitted them about one particular caller.
title: Truecaller Community Suggestions: What Is It, How Does It Work, Benefits and More

description: Fresh leaks suggest Xiaomi’s upcoming 17 Ultra could arrive globally in late February with a higher price and minor regional changes. Tipster Arsène Lupin claims the global 16GB RAM + 512GB storage variant may cost EUR 1,499 (roughly Rs. 1,60,100), significantly more than its China price. The global model is also tipped to feature a smaller 6,000mAh battery compared to the 6,800mAh unit in China. However, other core specifications, including charging speeds, display, cameras, and software, are expected to remain unchanged across regions.
title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra Global Variant Tipped to Launch With Smaller Battery; Price, Colour Options Leaked

description: Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and its partners announced the disruption of one of the world’s largest proxy networks last week. The Mountain View-based tech giant said that it was able to successfully take down IPIDEA, one of the most notorious proxy networks that has been operating in the shadows for quite some time.
title: Google Disrupts Massive Proxy Network That Hijacked Millions of Smartphones, PCs for Cyberattacks

description: The iQOO 15R is set to be launched in India soon as the latest addition to the flagship iQOO 15 lineup. The iQOO 15R will pack a considerably bigger battery than the 7,000mAh cell of the iQOO 15.
title: iQOO 15R Battery Capacity and Thickness Revealed Ahead of Launch in India

They feature a centrally-placed 12-megapixel camera with support for 1080p video recording at 60 frames per second (fps). Like the Ray-Ban Meta, the Oakley Meta Vanguard have Meta AI integration, enabling users to listen to or speak with Meta AI or on calls.
title: Oakley Meta Vanguard Launched in India With Meta AI Integration: Price, Specifications

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Appears in Leaked Promotional Poster With Redesigned Camera Island, New Colourway

title: The Game Awards 2026 Sets December 10 Date: Will GTA 6 Be Eligible?

On paper, that opens up Adobe’s “create-anything” platform to nearly 360 million people, giving them access to its design tools, artificial intelligence (AI) features, and a large library of stock assets for a year.
title: Exclusive: Adobe’s Govind Balakrishnan on Why Adoption Trumps Profit for Adobe Express

description: In recent years, Reels has become one of the most popular features on Instagram. As such, it has become a highly-used feature on the app. Reels are powered by a recommendation algorithm that recommends Reels to users based on their engagement and viewing patterns. There are, however, instances when content seems repetitive or not in line with your current interests. you can fix this by resetting your Instagram Reels algorithm.
title: How to Reset Your Instagram Reels Algorithm: A Step-by-Step Guide
